en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Evil of belief in occultation of the Imam can be proved by stating that it removes hardships and hurdles from the duty-bound (Mukallaf), because by keeping away assistance of the Imam, which in fact is a divine favor, and in the same way, fear of people of being reprimanded by the Imam [if they commit disobedience] is not achieved.
Thus it is a breach of divine grace on the duty-bound (Mukallaf)
and that is why belief in occultation is evil.
